pages.text: --- Page 1 --- SING'KAM CRYSTALCORNELIOUSD.MARAK basakobagrongtaigenial.?
--- Page 3 --- SING·KAM Mamatangni gisikode namchikgipako Arinna bia ka-ate on na sikachim aro Noknaba Arimko nammkengani gimin iana kusi ong'genchim.

Champenganirangko niksanisoe Arim Noknana agangija China A-weko wate re-angon, Nokna ka abee dongrikna nangaha.Adita sal aro janijamano,uni janggi tanganio gital ong'c re-mikkangtaioha, ua Arimko gualna manjaha.
Ua Arimko grongtaina man'genma --- sal aro somoini aganchakanikosa nichaksoaiaha..

--- Page 6 --- Agansoani "Sing kam," ine ia novelna angni biming donanio, A-chikni niam aro dakbewalrangko miksonga.
Jatni niam aro dakbewalrang A chik sakantini janggitanganiko sing.kam gita sikchakenga; uko chasongni kri namako ja-rike, nafngijanirang dongode namdapatna nanga.
A-chik a'songo bang'a nitogipa a-brirang, chibimarang, chidarerang aro warirang donga.
Uarangan A-chik a'songko mikkim ra'song chaatenggiparang ong'a.
A-songni ong'telaigipa gamrangko asongni silroro-namroroanina jakkalna nanga.
Seanimiksonganiona soknakam aro a'selrangko ong'ate novelko seaha.
Unigimin, iano bakko ra giparangni bimingrang aro kamrang dao tangenggipa melieode ba apsanangani dongode, uan maibakae meligakanisanong'aigen.
Ia novelna agandapaniko, Dr.(Mrs) Caroline R.
Marak, F'ormer Head of the Depariment of Garo, NEHU.
Tura Campus, see on-ahanina anga skigipako nitela.
Ua angni seanirangko namdapatnaba namgipa kupattianirangkoonaha.
lako semitingo, angna dakchakgiparang, Mukthi R.
Marak, Sachil Das aro Porthyna R.
Marakko initelna namnika.
Ki tapni bigilko tarian baksa segiminko nipilanio dakchakgipa, Melkior Ch.
Sangmako anga --- Page 7 --- mitela.
Sembertush A.
Sangmakoba ki-tapni bigilna noksa sale on'anina anga mitela.
Bon·kame, angni jikgipa Rakmelina D.
Sangma aro nokni manderangkoba ia novelko nakatatanio dakchakpaanina mitela.
Dated Sangsanggre, Crystal Cornelious D.
Marak Tura, The 29th January,2009.
--- Page 8 --- Agandapani Crystal Cornelious D.
Marak ia novelko uni Collegeo poraimitingoni a-bachenge, taridaproroe 2009 bilsini a·bachengo chapa ka'atenga.
Ia novelni mongsongbatgipa katta bichongrangara onga, A-chik societyni niamrang(customs)jerangon pangchake an'chingni society chasongni chasongna tangbangbaenga, aro jerangchin jatko rikbaenga.
Nok rikon sing'kamchi krongrangko mangrakata; ua singkam A-chikni niamrangni metaphor onga.
Pilak jatrangon niamchi nokdang aro songsarko chalaia; uamangni jora-ripeng baseanio, bia ka-anio, noksul- songsul dongrimanio, nokdangko chalaianio, bi-sarangko dal-atanio niamrangko ja'rika.
Uarangan rama mesokata.
Indiani Salgro-Salaramo Khasi, Jaintia aro A-chikrang matrilineal systemko ja-rika, ua systemara patriarchal systemoni bikpilani gimin, uko namen study ka'enga, aro scholarrang articlerangko seenga.
Una a'songtangni aro a'palchini scholarrang namen gisik on'cnga.
Author C.C.D.Marak jattangni systemko, niamrang aro uarangko maikai jakkalbaenga uko namekac nienga.
Chengoni atchu-ambini ja-rikbagipa niamrangoni jerangan nama, uarangko ripingna, namgijako galna ba namdapatna nanga ine author nikenga.
21gipa centuryni a-bachengao obostarang, janggitangani bewal, aro gadang chengoni chasongoni --- Page 9 --- dingtangaha; dingangani kri dakbewalrangko nipilna nanga.
la katta bichongko me'suatna aro poraigiparangko gisik nangatna Arim aro Noknani romanceko jakkale seaha.
C.C.D.
Marakni mongsonggipa gisik nanganian ia katta bichongo ong-a.
Gri sokchiko chawari rimani.
bia kaao amana batpile koros ka-ani, ma'manti dabianirangko dake koros japatani.
gro nangstipani, kam ba janggi tangani cholko dakchenggija bia ka-ani, sia bon'ao kagipa kamrang, kakket ong'gijani, til-ekani, on'songaniojakkegijani,akim watani, uandakgiparangko nie author seaha.
Gipin katta bichongranga ong'a environmentni gimin niani, Shillongna agreba Garo Hilisni nitoani, a'songtangna chanchiani.
Shillongo dal-kape Arim Garo Hillsni giminde bang'e uija; ua uko ding'a aro a'dimurara inesa chanchia.
Arimni mikronchi author Achik a'songni chiring..
chibima, akawe, chibol, a-bri aro rokomari bol-wa-arangko knatoe agane mesoka.
Arim a'songtangko wachikario nike katchaa.
Environment,natural resources ba ongtelaigipa gamrangko namroroanina jakkalani giminba seaha.
Nongal Bibrao koela a-damo chogipa aro badinggiparang tangka bangen man-a; indiba ua tangkako name jakkalna simsakgija chae ringesa bon'ata.
Tangkachi skia-pora man'aniko bariatna tikkelani gri, rama jal-angrang nambatatna jotton kaani gri; indiba gamrangde bon-angenga.
Samtangtangni --- Page 10 --- (environment) nengnikanirang, jekai wa-rama, akkal- karap ong'na kenchakanikoba mesoka.
Chrarang badita bil gnang aro gisik gnanggiparang baditana kingking nokdangko saldona man'a, ia novelo mesoka.
Arimko mamatang noktango dongate poraiata, kamba man'na dakchaka, ku-pattia.
indiba ua uko chawarina kangja.
Ua bi-sani aro uni ma'gipani cholgrianiko nike dakchakaha.
Bia ka'ato biltangna batpile koros ka'ani da'ororo A-chikrango ranta donga; bang'an pattal aro baganrangko bondok done uarangni incomekoba man jaha aro bon-kamao gimaata.
Dabianirang korosko batate nokdangni economyko salona.
Mitamrango, bia ka-ani ja'mano jikse maikai janggi tanggen, me-asa aro me-chikni, aro uamangni dolgni maharinin chanchisoani gri.
Mitamrang kamn gri, unigimin badiaba nokdangrang sildoani pal tang'ona.
Do-meni bia ka'anio iarangko mesoka.
Rangtongni an-tangna mande on·songna skangan skatang basee til-ekon uko a-kim watna ga'aka; unon ua noktangko aro demechikko wate ong'katna nanga.
Ua maming mal bostuko kangna man'ja.
Mitamrang dilsretako man'a; indiba mitamrang Arin gita an-tangtangni gualako nikpile, an-tangtangko namatpilnajotton kaa.
Namgijagipa dakbewalrangko take seoba, uuthor A-chikrangni nama dakbewalrangkoba, jekai dakchakgrikani aro kakket ongani gunrangkoba mesoka.
